title: PLAYER 2 SUPPRESSES WITH NEAR MISSES
why: The cloud review found that only rounds that landed counted for player 2 in the suppression of a pillager: the near misses that pin a man for the host were never seen by the host for player 2. His window now counts the rounds that go past a man (once each, as the host does) and tells the host, and the host counts them, so a Support MG in the hands of player 2 pins a pillager as it does for player 1.
now: Player 2 near misses now pin a pillager the way the host near misses do.
